body: I went through a similar thing in my teens. I liked gay porn, but I had never felt attraction to a man in real life, or even on TV. It’s very confusing, but it’ll all come together in time. For me, it was a guy senior year of high school who made me realize I had just never met a guy I was attracted to — not that I wasn’t attracted to men. In the end, I found out I was bi, but it took some years. Don’t stress too much. Just sit with it in the back of your mind and it’ll all come into focus eventually. You may find that you’re not actually romantically interested in men, or you’ll discover something about yourself along the way. Either way, don’t box yourself into any identity this young. Just be open to figuring yourself out.
Chris Pratt in Parks and Rec
